participant_1.name: Emily
participant_1.personality: Curious and thoughtful, with a love for music and nature.
participant_1.background: I can drive a tractor. I enjoy listening to classical music. My favorite color is red. My sister is a pole dancer. I'm a Christian.

participant_2.name: Jack
participant_2.personality: Playful and nostalgic, with a fondness for wine and dancing.
participant_2.background: I am 100 years old. I love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight. I am very strong for my age. I feel like I might live forever. I remember when nobody had a television.
